title: Dental SEO Marketing: Google Ads Mistakes Dentists Make

facts.fact: The Dental Rank article 'The Top 5 Google Ads Mistakes That Cost Dentists Thousands' was published on 2025-07-21.
Dental Rank's article lists five Google Ads mistakes that dentists frequently make.
facts.quote: Let’s take a look at the top 5 Google Ads mistakes dentists frequently make, and how you can quickly fix them.

facts.fact: Dental Rank advises that location targeting for dental Google Ads typically use a 5-10 km radius around the practice.
Dental Rank lists 'free,' 'cheap,' 'jobs,' and 'DIY' as common negative keywords for dental practices.
facts.quote: Common negative keywords for dental practices include “free,” “cheap,” “jobs,” and “DIY.”

facts.fact: Dental Rank gives '$99 New Patient Check-Up in Melbourne' as an example of a specific ad headline offer for dental clinics.
facts.quote: Consider headlines like “$99 New Patient Check-Up in Melbourne,”

facts.fact: Dental Rank recommends setting aside time monthly to analyse Google Ads performance and adjust campaigns.
facts.quote: Set aside time monthly to analyse ad performance, test new ad creatives, adjust targeting, and refine your bidding strategies.
